description: Fork of exp493 (MatmulMHL softmax, fast soft-mixture). ADD temperature loss: total = CE + temp_penalty * sum_modules(T_sel), temp_penalty=0.01. Pushes the learnable T_sel DOWN -> sharper softmax routing toward argmax. Goals: (1) faster convergence/better inductive bias, (2) HARDENABILITY - if T_sel gets small enough, softmax~argmax so the soft-trained model can be hardened to single-lookup matmul-free inference (the deploy caveat of soft-mixture). Soft pressure on a LEARNABLE temp (unlike exp483's failed forced anneal). Eval bpb = pure CE (fair). Watch T_sel in temperatures.csv + whether argmax-hardened eval ~ soft eval. vs exp493/exp475/exp444.
